summary: InMode Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held July 30, 2026, covering routine items: re-election of a Class I director, reappointment of auditors, approval of restricted share units for non-executive directors, and compensation terms for the Special Committee. Quorum of 54.71% was present; all four proposals passed. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, buybacks, or restructuring.
